description: Non-Kona raw sensor captures for pipeline regression testing
notes: These captures were taken with the TCS3530 sensor under LED illumination
unless led_enabled is false.  Use scripts/color_replay.py to replay them
through the pipeline or convert them to the batch text format.
gain field is the raw gain-code byte reported by tcs3530_driver (not the
expected.category is compared against the pipeline 'category' output.
expected.max_delta_e (optional) fails if result.delta_e exceeds the value.

captures.description: Green wall paint misclassified as Yellow/Pale — known calibration issue
captures.notes: scan_lab a* ≈ -1.6 is nearly neutral (should be ≈ -20 to -50 for a real green). Root cause is sensor-correction / calibration matrix, not the colour matcher. Use color_replay_inspect to compare intermediate pipeline stages across commits. No expected category set so CI does not fail while the bug is open.
